notes: Strong Trick Shot opener, then sat clicking for credits up to 31 with nothing to spend them on. Ignored a stream of naked or lightly iced remotes, so the Corp scored three agendas uncontested.

Kept putting agendas into the same one-ice remote and advancing them one click a turn while the Runner simply tanked Tsarevna. Four agendas were stolen that way and another from HQ; it also clicked for credits while holding 15+.
Sat at 0 credits for about 20 turns, running HQ four times a turn through VSA, piling up tags and declining every Bellona/Degree Mill it could not afford. Won only because the Corp decked.
Reasonable Weyland play: iced remotes, advanced ice for credits and scored three Send a Message. It was slow and over-banked late (40 credits) against a passive Runner.
Tight, aggressive game: built economy, pressured HQ/R&D and installed cheap cards so it could pay Degree Mill's cost. Won on turn 6.
Clicked for credits nearly every turn and discarded at end of turn instead of installing agendas or more ice. HQ, guarded only by Ping, leaked four agendas; End of the Line was the only real play.
Built an engine and broke HQ well with Audrey/Devil Charm. It wasted turns on low-value Archives runs and three times ran into Semak-samun on R&D with no way through.
Clicked for credits to 26 for five turns without running and let Regenesis score. Then it took Anansi's net damage and ran into the same Anansi again with a small grip, flatlining itself.
Never installed an agenda or protected HQ beyond Ping, so three agendas were stolen from HQ. It spent turns 10-14 and all its money repeatedly trashing resources, sitting at 1 credit.
Solid scoring remote, good use of Built to Last and three protected scores. It over-banked (30+ credits) by playing Government Subsidy with nothing to spend on.
Scored from an iced remote and won by flatline with Byte! in HQ. It left both centrals unprotected for nine turns, and Fujii was stolen from open HQ.
Stayed tagged against NBN after Oppo Research and lost four cards to End of the Line. The mid-game was slow, with Archives runs and Ping bounces while the Corp scored, before a strong close.
Clicked for credits and discarded for about ten turns with R&D unprotected and 20+ credits banked, giving up 6 points from R&D. It later built a working two-ice remote and won.

At 0 credits for 20 turns, it ran R&D four times a turn, often re-accessing the same top card (Behold! three times in a row), took piles of tags and never rebuilt economy. Won only because the Corp decked.
Good early steals, then a long slow middle in which two SDS scored. It eventually won by grinding R&D, but paid 7 a run on HQ for little return and spent many clicks on Archives.
Spent its first two turns clicking for credits with no ice anywhere while HQ was full of agendas. It lost on turn 3.

Never answered Akhet on the scoring remote and paid 5 a run into HQ instead. On the final turn it spent its money on HQ before Pinhole Threading, so it could not pay to steal the game-winning Send a Message.
Wasted early turns clicking for credits and discarding at 14-22 credits, then overspent on rezzes and sat near 0 for several turns. Still scored steadily from iced remotes and won.
Semak-samun remote scored two agendas, and Fujii behind a single Anemone plus Phat set up the flatline. R&D was open early and it clicked for credits while banking 20-30.
Correctly hammered an unprotected R&D and won on turn 5. Many repeat R&D runs within a turn could only see the same top card, while it sat at 0 credits.
